docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-19-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-19-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM ERIC GROVER. PLAINTIFF JONATHAN BURBAUM IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AIRBNB, INC. IS PRESENT VIA PHONE DIAL-IN BY ZOOM DUE TO TECHNICAL ISSUE WITH DEFENDANT'S NAME NOT APPEARING ON THE ATTENDEES LIST IN ZOOM, REPRESENTED BY TABITHA LANG (EMPLOYEE REPRESENTATIVE). DEFENDANT ORALLY STIPULATION TO USE JUDGE PRO TEM. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT WAIVES PROOF OF SERVICE. PLAINTIFF EMAILED COPY OF EXHIBITS TO DEPT. 506'S EMAIL. PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS INCLUDING A VIDEO ARE EMAILED TO DEFENDANT DURING COURT PROCEEDING. COURT TOOK RECESS AT 4:19 P.M. FOR DEFENDANT TO REVIEW PLAINTIFF EVIDENCE AND TRIAL RESUMED AT 4:30 P.M.. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
